description: Defines the SystemTrustStore interface and related factory functions for managing platform-specific SSL trust stores, including Chrome Root Store support and platform-specific initialization functions.

classes.name: SystemTrustStore
classes.description: Interface for encapsulating platform-specific trust store management, including trust anchors, system trust store usage, and Chrome Root Store support.

methods.name: GetTrustStore
methods.description: Returns a TrustStore object for path building, combining system and manually added trust anchors.

methods.name: UsesSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Indicates whether the implementation uses the system's trust store.

methods.name: IsKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is a known root from the system trust store.

methods.name: chrome_root_store_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Chrome Root Store if supported.
